name: Missing Loop in Robot
hint: A robot sensor condition is checked once outside a loop, so later changes are ignored and the robot can respond only to its initial state.
instruction: Place the sensing condition and its response inside an appropriate forever or until loop, or use an event-driven hat for each occurrence.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <@codeyB shaken ? :: sensing> then
say [Shaken]
end
